priority: Recover supported room coverage from preserved photos, then demonstrate appearance and local web usability. Do not optimize a weighted efficiency score before coverage works.
threshold_note: Proposed engineering acceptance defaults; freeze before results. Not measured accuracy or a promise of realism. Do not silently relax thresholds; mark failures and use a new protocol version if a correction is necessary.

scope.allowed_delivery: New isolated local preview revision/source, using existing app workflow. Open only after the displayed asset is verified. Never mislabel a single-room preview as full-floor.

inventory.frame_priority: All valid original photo/pose pairs, not only the existing 400-frame prepared center export. Video extraction only if originals demonstrably omit needed frames with recoverable timing/poses.

split.benchmark_role: Supported-surface novel-view interpolation; separately label extrapolation into never-photographed regions. Do not solve extrapolation by hiding it from reports.
freeze_order: inventory metadata/hash and deterministic quality/duplicate summaries
reserve grouped validation and fresh final-test identities
define fixed geometry target and validation ROIs
select training pool subset by training-only coverage

near_duplicate_guard_initial.rule: Group temporally adjacent views within 1 s when reliable timestamps exist, or visually near-identical views with nearby poses; confirm grouping with image similarity. These are initial duplicate checks, not proof of independence. Do not use a transitive temporal chain that absorbs the entire walk.

split.legacy_r001_r003_views: Exposed diagnostic set, not pristine final-test evidence. Retain their failures for comparison but do not tune to them and call the result independent.
split.unknown_test_history: May deliver a clearly labeled diagnostic preview, but no final-test or release pass.
split.same_workload_comparison: Old32-photo results are historical context only. Same-split baseline and candidate must share explicit training identities, prepared resolution, mask behavior, target, renderer and evaluation IDs; document algorithmic differences.
split.critical_rois: Freeze separate validation and test critical-feature ROIs from actual evidence. Missing outlet detail is a feature limitation, not permission to invent it or omit the limitation.

coverage.probe_method: Area-weighted sampling of nondegenerate measured mesh triangles, reproducible barycentric coordinates and triangle IDs. Keep probe set and denominator fixed across frame counts/configs.
coverage.target_definition: Freeze geometry-only task surfaces and zone IDs before selecting photos: library-facing surfaces visible from the proposed traversal/inspection poses. Report all-mesh coverage alongside target coverage. Never redefine the target to omit holes after seeing photos.
coverage.visibility: Positive camera depth; calibrated in-frame projection; triangle/ray-based occlusion; verified surface side/orientation; static mask; usable photo detail. Missing depth is unknown, never automatically visible.
coverage.existing_visibility_warning: scan_colour._weights_from currently treats nonfinite nearest depth as unhidden; validate/fix that path before trusting coverage. Vertex-splat depth is not automatically a reliable triangle occlusion test.

independent_second_view.rule: Distinct accepted duplicate groups, plus baseline OR ray-angle criterion. Record actual geometry and group IDs. Two adjacent frames do not establish independent support.

acceptance.if_reference_already_above_target: Do not regress; require the other coverage/detail checks. References are recomputed on the same fixed probes.

audit_pairs.distribution: 8 supported,8 rejected,8 unknown, stratified over zones and rejection causes. Inspect image overlays plus mesh depth. Zero known false-visible wall-crossing samples allowed; any such failure blocks coverage acceptance.

coverage.occlusion_tolerance: Freeze from synthetic fixtures and measured calibration residuals before photo selection; record numerical value. Never increase it merely to obtain more painted pixels.
coverage.reference_32_rule: Use the first32 of the new nested selection from the NEW approved training pool, not legacy32 images that might overlap the new holdouts.

photo_selection.conditional_extension: Only if 250 misses coverage goals and remaining approved frames add measured supported area; log the marginal benefit. If original pool has fewer valid frames, report that limit.
photo_selection.selection_objective: Greedy area-weighted new support plus independent second-view support, weighted by training-image sharpness/static validity/projected detail. Promote per-zone coverage before redundant close-ups. Stable identity tie-breaks; seed1729.
photo_selection.stop_requires: If targets are met, stop on low marginal gain. If targets are unmet, low gain triggers a visibility/pose/quality diagnosis before declaring capture-limited.
photo_selection.detail_rule: Reserve up to15% of selected views/samples for photo-supported outlets/boards/tabletops; do not claim small-feature recognition from RGB coverage alone.
photo_selection.quality_checks: Reject undecodable/wrong-pose frames; record blur/exposure/motion/person rejection per image. Freeze quality thresholds on training inventory diagnostics; no universal arbitrary blur number.

sampling.retention_definition: Accepted exported samples / proposed samples from the frozen supported domain, before final numerical cleanup. Pruning most of a whole-room proposal is not support-first sampling.
sampling.partial_triangles: A supported interior may exist even if a triangle corner is unseen. Use bounded subdivision or sample-level visibility; do not label all corners/entire face supported from one observation.
sampling.mask_resize: Conservative validity with tested arbitrary source/target dimensions; no unsupported fractional block reshape assumptions.
sampling.density_and_scale: Compute effective density/neighbor spacing on the actual supported surface after the cap; do not use a nominal spacing that the capped sampler cannot achieve. Calibrate projected splat sizes per surface without spreading across walls/openings/occlusions.
sampling.opacity: front-to-back transmittance,1-product(1-alpha); no additive-alpha saturation claim
sampling.critical_features: Never enlarge splats merely to conceal holes or blur outlets into a wall.

appearance.preferred_masked_training_backend: Existing Brush mask-capable path with binary behavior proven; SplatX training only on an explicitly unmasked diagnostic or after native loss-mask support is verified.
routes_in_order: existing LiDAR mesh with real photographic texture/vertex-color base if fitting current pipeline
bounded existing-trainer refinement if coverage is good but appearance is poor
additional_acceptance: No blank evaluated or traversal view with known photographed static geometry in front of the camera.
No new/worse ghost people, floating duplicate furniture, blocked visual doorway or erased critical feature on paired review.
All expected view images and preregistered ROIs exist with correct camera identity.
PSNR/SSIM come from actual RGBs and frozen masks, never supplied summary values alone.
appearance.previews_vs_claims: A larger-data coverage improvement is not an equal-data speedup. A local diagnostic preview is not a completed photorealistic floor.

evidence_guard.review_record: Typed schema with reviewer identity, scene/view hashes, observations and explicit verdict. Machine validation establishes record completeness, not independent truth of subjective review.
evidence_guard.final_test: Separate validation_shortlisted from final_test_passed. No selected-for-review final status without sealed test evidence.
evidence_guard.performance_measurement: Only claim efficiency after three alternating runs including preprocessing and compression, comparable process-footprint method and genuine hardware-rendered viewer traces. Single-run times may be labeled diagnostics.

multi_scan.camera_relation: If T maps local room points to global, global world-to-camera = local world-to-camera @ inverse(T); global c2w = T @ local c2w. Validate actual stored conventions first.
multi_scan.disagreement: Record overlap reprojection/geometry residuals. Refuse color fusion across inconsistent surfaces; separate patches with flagged seams until corrected.
multi_scan.full_floor_claim: Requires all four captures in a common verified frame, actual browser source/asset checks, traversable joins, coverage/quality per room and disclosure of remaining unknowns.

web_delivery.isolation: New local preview source/revision through existing app machinery; preserve current default and originals.
verify: Actual asset request hashes match new manifest; no silent old-asset fallback.
Selected room/floor, scan ID/revision and render source are visible and accurate.
Desktop path, seated traversal, collision and room transitions remain usable.
Desktop and narrow/mobile layouts; no claim of physical-phone testing without a device.
Exports preserve units, measured geometry vs appearance distinction, revision and evidence.
Console/network failures and actual hardware renderer identity recorded.
web_delivery.when_not_successful: Leave stable scene unchanged; provide failed view evidence and precise next action. Do not open an incomplete room as the fully rendered floor.

capture_request_rule: Only after testing all useful approved existing photos and plausible visibility/pose hypotheses. List exact surfaces, missing viewing directions and desired close-up detail; no generic request to rescan everything.
